translations.web: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.
translations.bsb: The cursing that he wore like a coat, may it soak into his body like water, and into his bones like oil.
translations.kjv: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
translations.asv: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment, And it came into his inward parts like water, And like oil into his bones.
